resources.string: No plugins yet. Import a plugin manifest (.json) to get started.
Tap to switch a plugin on or off. Long-press for details or to delete it.

A plugin is a .json manifest. Rule plugins replace text in messages you send or in how messages are shown, or cancel requests by name; they can\'t run code. A code plugin also needs its .dex/.jar file; import both. New plugins start switched off. Files are kept in Mercurygram\'s private storage.

Code plugins are Java code running inside Mercurygram with full access to your chats and accounts. They are not sandboxed. A code plugin is switched off again automatically when its code file changes.
Code plugins can read and send messages, see your account data and send network requests as you. Only allow this for plugins you built or fully trust.
This plugin runs code with Mercurygram\'s full access to your chats and accounts. Enable it only if you trust its author.
